title: Patient Financial Counseling and Estimates
summary: Proactive patient financial counseling and upfront cost estimates improve collections, reduce bad debt, and increase patient satisfaction.
objectives: Explain the components of effective patient financial counseling
Describe how price transparency regulations affect patient estimates
Identify best practices for upfront collection of patient responsibility

content_blocks.body:
High-deductible health plans (HDHPs) have shifted significant financial responsibility to patients. In 2024, about 27% of covered workers were enrolled in a high-deductible plan with a savings option (KFF Employer Health Benefits Survey). As a result:

- Patient balances are a growing share of provider revenue
- Bad debt from patient responsibility has become a major collections risk
- Patient financial experience increasingly shapes overall patient satisfaction

Organizations that invest in financial counseling and transparent estimates can improve upfront collections.
content_blocks.heading: The Rise of Patient Financial Responsibility

content_blocks.body:
Two federal mandates now require providers to publish pricing:

**Hospital Price Transparency Rule (2021):** Hospitals must publish machine-readable files with all standard charges and a consumer-friendly display of 300 shoppable services. CMS strengthened enforcement in 2022–2023, with penalties up to about $2M per year for the largest hospitals.

**No Surprises Act (2022):** Prohibits surprise billing for emergency care and non-emergency care at in-network facilities. Requires Good Faith Estimates for uninsured and self-pay patients (generally within 1–3 business days of scheduling); the advance explanation of benefits for insured patients has been deferred pending further rulemaking.
content_blocks.heading: Price Transparency Requirements

content_blocks.body: Financial counselors should routinely screen patients for charity care eligibility using income verification. Many organizations use Medicaid presumptive eligibility screening simultaneously. Proactive screening reduces bad debt write-offs and ensures patients receive benefits they are entitled to.
